Undo with agent-archive backfill undo 2026-09-25-1.

To set up another Mac with this storage, run there:
  agent-archive setup --yes --provider s3 --bucket team-archive --aws-profile work --region us-east-1 --apps claude --project ~/src/web-app
[exit 0]
